_comment: Scripted play-throughs. Every position, range and line of sight in these scripts was checked against the app's own rules engine (rangeBetween / losBetween) using the scenario's real terrain, and every stat quoted comes from data/cards.json. Dice are fixed: each entry is a face index into data/dice.json, so the icons shown are real faces of that die.
_dice: red 0-3 Heavy Hit, 4-5 hollow Heavy Hit, 6 Lightning, 7 Eye. yellow 0-1 two Light Hits, 2-3 Light Hit, 4 hollow Light Hit, 5 Lightning, 6 Eye, 7 blank. white 0 Defense, 1-2 two hollow Defense, 3 Dodge, 4-5 Lightning, 6 Eye, 7 blank. blue 0-1 Dodge, 2-3 Eye, 4 Lightning, 5-7 blank. black 0 Torso, 1 Chassis, 2 L.Arm, 3 R.Arm, 4 Backpack, 5 attacker chooses.

replays.title: RDL Core Box Demo, played through
intro: A complete three-round game, resolved step by step with every dice roll shown. The rolls are fixed rather than random, so the same situations occur on every viewing.
Two identical RDL forces of 366 points. Red deploys west, Blue east. Each side fields two M.A.P.s and one Hyena missile drone.
Board on the right, dice tray on the left, commentary here. Step forward and back with the controls above the board.

steps.title: The board
say: Six units on a 12 by 12 field of large grids. Red deploys on the west edge, Blue on the east.
Terrain: 3-inch buildings at F6 and G7, 3-inch walls at E5, H5, E8 and H8. All four block line of sight.
The consequence is that no line of sight crosses the centre. Row 4 and row 9 are the only clear lanes across the board, and the four relay markers at F4, G4, F9 and G9 sit inside them.
The two control markers at F7 and G6 sit within the blocked area. They score for presence rather than for shooting, which is what makes them worth contesting.

steps.title: Command Phase
say: Each Mech generates 1 Command Token. Both sides field two Mechs, so both start with 2.
Players alternate spending 1 token to issue a Command to one Drone, beginning with the First Player. A commanded Drone resolves immediately.
Red is First Player this round. Unspent tokens are removed at the end of the phase and do not carry over.

steps.title: Red commands its Hyena
say: Red spends 1 token. The DTG-30S Hyena Missile Type has Move 5.
It moves B6 to C9, a distance of 4, into the southern lane.
Red fields only one Drone, so the second token has no legal target and is removed.

steps.title: Blue commands its Hyena
say: Blue spends 1 token to move its Hyena from K7 to J9, a distance of 3.
A commanded Drone performs either 1 Movement Action or 1 Command Action, not both, so neither Drone has launched this round.
All unspent Command Tokens are now removed.

steps.title: Planning Phase
say: Each Mech sets its Timing Dial face down, then both players reveal simultaneously.
All four Mechs select Movement. No unit is within weapon range of an enemy.
The dial fixes both the activation order and the permitted action type. A Mech set to Movement cannot perform a Firing Action this round.

steps.title: Action Phase, Movement timing
say: Activation order follows the timing sequence: Swift, Melee, Projectile, Firing, Movement, Tactical.
All four Mechs are on Movement, so they resolve in that step. Within a step, ties are broken by Pilot Initiative and then by the First Player.
Each activation provides 1 Maneuver Tick followed by 2 Action Ticks. One grid of movement costs the Maneuver Tick; a Move Action printed on the chassis card costs Action Ticks.

steps.title: Red Fire Support takes the north lane
say: Maneuver Tick: A5 to A4.
Move Action: RL-08 Armored Chassis, Jet Dash, Range 3, with [Moving in Straight Line] granting +2 grids. A4 to D4 is 3 grids due east.
Final position D4, in the clear northern lane. Armament is the R-20 Shoulder-Mounted Railgun in the left arm and the AC-150 HMG in the right.

steps.title: Blue Bulwark mirrors it
say: Blue performs the same sequence: Maneuver L5 to L4, then Jet Dash 3 grids west to I4.
D4 to I4 measures range 5 with clear line of sight, checked against the terrain layout.
Both units are heavy weapon platforms holding an open lane. Either can fire on the other next round without repositioning, which also qualifies them for their [Stationary] bonuses.

steps.title: Both skirmishers go south
say: Red Support Skirmisher: Maneuver A8 to A9, then RL-06 Standard Chassis Sprint, Range 4, three grids east to D9.
Blue Missile / Brawler: Maneuver L8 to L9, then Sprint three grids west to I9.
Southern lane occupancy is now Red at C9 and D9, Blue at I9 and J9. Line of sight along row 9 is clear end to end.

steps.title: Automatic Phase
say: Drones not commanded during the Command Phase act here, forced to target the nearest enemy.
Both Drones were commanded, so neither acts again. A Drone acts once per round either way; the Command Token buys control over which action it takes.

steps.title: Delay Phase
say: No projectiles or deployables are on the board, so nothing resolves. This phase exists for delayed actions such as missile detonation.

steps.title: End Phase, and nobody scores
say: Sequence: remove Mechs at 2 or fewer Parts, remove Red tokens, flip Yellow tokens, remove all Command Tokens, then score.
Centre presence requires a M.A.P. on or adjacent to F7 or G6. Relay pressure requires a M.A.P. on or adjacent to a relay marker. Drones do not satisfy either condition.
D4 and I4 are 3 grids from the nearest relay. D9 and I9 are 2 grids from F9 and G9. Neither condition is met by either side.
Score after round 1: Red 0, Blue 0. First Player passes to Blue.

steps.title: Round 2, Command Phase
say: Both sides generate 2 Command Tokens. Blue is First Player and commands first.
Blue moves its Hyena from J9 to H9, a distance of 2.
Red moves its Hyena from C9 to F9, a distance of 3, onto a relay marker. A Drone on a relay does not score relay pressure, but it does contest the space.

steps.title: Planning Phase
say: Dials this round: Red Fire Support on Firing, Blue Bulwark on Firing, Blue Missile / Brawler on Projectile, Red Support Skirmisher on Movement.
Projectile resolves before Firing in the timing sequence, so the missile launches before either Mech fires. Timing selection controls sequencing as much as it controls the action.

steps.title: Projectile timing: Blue launches
say: ML-34 Quad Missile Rack: Projectile action, Range 3, Volley 2, Fire in arc, 4 missiles stored.
Blue launches 1 MC-3 Razor Missile from I9 to F9, a distance of 3, within the forward arc. Red's Hyena occupies F9.
The missile is placed on the board as a unit. Its Guided Attack is a Delay action, so it resolves in the Delay Phase rather than now.
Launching consumes 1 Ammo Token from the rack, flipped face down.

steps.title: Firing timing: Blue shoots first
say: Blue is First Player, so the Bulwark Heavy activates first.
AC-150 HMG, Full-auto: Range 8, 5 Yellow Dice, with [Stationary] +1 Yellow and the Suppression keyword.
The Bulwark has not moved this round, so [Stationary] applies, giving 6 Yellow Dice.
Target is Red's Fire Support at D4, range 5, clear line of sight. Blue is in Offensive Stance, which converts hollow attack icons to solid.

steps.title: Which Part gets hit

dice.reading: Chassis. The shot lands on the RL-08 Armored Chassis: Armor 6, Structure 1.

say: Rulebook 4.4 step 2: the Black Die determines the Part before any attack dice are rolled.
Result is Chassis. The target Part is the RL-08 Armored Chassis, Armor 6, Structure 1.

steps.title: Blue's attack roll

dice.reading: 2 + 1 + 1 Light Hits, one hollow Light Hit made solid by Offensive Stance, one Eye, one blank. Total 5 Light Hits.

say: 6 Yellow Dice. Yellow faces show one or two Light Hits, with one face showing a hollow Light Hit.
Result: 4 solid Light Hits, 1 hollow Light Hit, 1 Eye, 1 blank.
Offensive Stance converts the hollow, giving 5 Light Hits.

steps.title: Red's defence roll

dice.reading: 2 Defense, 1 Dodge, 2 hollow Defense that do nothing, 1 Eye, 1 blank.

say: Line of sight is clear, so no Terrain or Unit Protection dice are added. The pool is the target Part's Armor value: 6 White.
Result: 2 Defense, 2 hollow Defense, 1 Dodge, 1 Eye.
Red is in Offensive Stance. That converts hollow attack icons, not hollow defence icons, so the 2 hollow Defense contribute nothing. Defensive Stance would have converted them.
Usable defence: 2 Defense and 1 Dodge against 5 Light Hits.

steps.title: Offsetting, and a Damaged Token
say: Offsetting rules: 1 Dodge offsets any 1 damage icon, 1 Defense offsets 1 Light Hit only.
All incoming icons are Light Hits, so all three defence icons are usable. 5 minus 3 leaves 2 unoffset.
Unoffset damage means Penetration on the chassis.

The chassis has Structure 1, so it is not destroyed. It receives a Damaged Token, and a Damaged Part rolls its Structure value instead of its Armor value. That Part now contributes 1 White die rather than 6.

steps.title: Red answers with the railgun
say: Red's Fire Support activates second within the same Firing step.
R-20 Shoulder-Mounted Railgun, Single Shot: Range 6, 3 Red Dice, with [Stationary] Range +2 and Armor Piercing 1.
It has not moved, so effective range is 8 against a target at range 5.
Red Dice produce Heavy Hits where Yellow Dice produce Light Hits. The offsetting rules treat the two differently, which decides this exchange.

steps.title: Hit location and the attack

dice.reading: Right Arm. Then 2 Heavy Hits plus a hollow Heavy Hit, made solid by Offensive Stance. Total 3 Heavy Hits.

say: Black Die: Right Arm. The target Part is Blue's AC-150 HMG, Armor 4, with no Structure value.
Attack roll of 3 Red: 2 solid Heavy Hits and 1 hollow Heavy Hit. Offensive Stance converts the hollow, giving 3 Heavy Hits.

steps.title: Armor Piercing bites

dice.note: 3 White: Armor 4 minus 1 for Armor Piercing
dice.reading: 1 Defense, 2 hollow Defense that do nothing in Offensive Stance, 1 Lightning.

say: Armor Piercing 1 removes 1 die from the defence pool, so Armor 4 rolls 3 White.
Result: 1 Defense, 2 hollow Defense, 1 Lightning. Blue is in Offensive Stance, so the hollows do not convert.
Usable defence: 1 Defense.

steps.title: Defense cannot stop Heavy Hits
say: Defense icons offset Light Hits only. The incoming damage is 3 Heavy Hits, so the single Defense icon offsets nothing.
3 unoffset Heavy Hits produce Penetration.
The AC-150 HMG has no Structure value, so a single Penetration destroys it outright rather than damaging it.
Part destruction effects: the card is flipped face down, the Part contributes no values and performs no actions, and the Mech loses 1 Link. Blue's Bulwark drops from 4 Link to 3.
Red scores Part destruction, worth 1 VP once per game.

steps.title: Movement timing: Red repositions
say: Red's Support Skirmisher moves 1 grid, D9 to E9, of the 4 that Sprint allows.
From E9, the Blue Missile / Brawler at I9 is range 4 with clear line of sight, inside the AC-32 Automatic Rifle's Range 6.
From E9, the Blue Bulwark at I4 is blocked: that line passes through the buildings at F6 and G7. A unit in one lane cannot support the other, which is why the two fights resolve independently.
E9 is also adjacent to the F9 relay, which matters at the End Phase.

steps.title: Automatic Phase
say: Both Drones were commanded this round, so neither acts here.

steps.title: Delay Phase: the missile finds its mark
say: Delayed actions resolve in this phase, alternating from the First Player.
MC-3 Razor Missile, Guided Attack: target 1 Enemy Unit within Range 3, fly into that unit's grid and undergo Detonation.
Red's Hyena occupies F9, which is the missile's own grid, so the target is at range 0.

steps.title: Detonation, both rolls side by side

dice.reading: Attack: 2 Heavy Hits, 2 Light Hits, 1 Lightning. Defence: 1 Defense, 1 Dodge, plus hollows and blanks that do nothing.

say: Attack and defence are shown together here. The upper group is the attack, the lower group is the defence.
Explosion damage allows no Terrain or Unit Protection, so the defence pool is the Drone's Armor value of 5 and nothing else.
Attack: 2 Heavy Hits, 2 Light Hits, 1 Lightning. Defence: 1 Defense, 1 Dodge, plus hollows that do not convert.
The Dodge offsets 1 Heavy Hit and the Defense offsets 1 Light Hit, leaving 1 Heavy Hit and 1 Light Hit unoffset. Penetration.

A Drone is a single Part with Armor 5 and Structure 2. The first Penetration would apply a Damaged Token, and the remaining damage destroys it. Destroyed Drones are removed from the board immediately.
A projectile that detonates is destroyed as well, so the missile is also removed.

steps.title: End Phase and scoring
say: Scoring conditions are checked by position, and both centre presence and relay pressure require a M.A.P. rather than a Drone.
Red: the Support Skirmisher at E9 is adjacent to the F9 relay, so relay pressure scores. Combined with Part destruction earlier, Red takes 2 this round.

Blue: the Hyena at H9 is adjacent to the G9 relay but is a Drone, so it does not qualify. The Missile / Brawler at I9 is 2 grids from G9, which is not adjacent. Blue scores no position points, but takes Projectile lesson and Drone kill from the detonation, so 2 this round as well.
Running score: Red 2, Blue 2. First Player passes back to Red.

do.why: Relay pressure: Skirmisher adjacent to F9

steps.title: Round 3, the last round
say: Final round, with the score level at 2 apiece. All remaining VP is decided at this End Phase.
Force state: Red has both Mechs, one with a Damaged chassis. Blue has both Mechs, one with a destroyed AC-150 HMG and 3 Link, plus its Drone.

Red is First Player and generates 2 Command Tokens, but has no Drone left. Command Tokens can only be issued to Drones, so both are removed unspent. Losing a Drone removes the use of two tokens every subsequent round.

steps.title: Blue's drone launches
say: Blue spends 1 token on its Hyena. The Drone's Missile action is marked with command speed, so a commanded Drone may launch instead of moving.
Launch from H9 to E9, a distance of 3, at the limit of Range 3. Red's Support Skirmisher occupies E9.
The missile resolves in the Delay Phase, as before.

steps.title: Planning Phase
say: Dials: Red Fire Support on Firing, Red Support Skirmisher on Movement, Blue Bulwark on Movement, Blue Missile / Brawler on Firing.
Stances: Blue Bulwark takes Defensive, Red Support Skirmisher takes Mobility, the other two remain Offensive.
The Bulwark has no working weapon, so Firing would achieve nothing. Movement lets it contest an objective instead, which is the only value it has left.

steps.title: Firing timing: the railgun again
say: Red is First Player. The Fire Support has not moved, so [Stationary] applies again: effective Range 8 against a target at range 5 with clear line of sight.
Blue is in Defensive Stance this round, which converts hollow Defense icons to solid. This is the stance built for absorbing fire.

steps.title: Five Defense icons, and it still lands

groups.label: Black Die, then Red attacks: 3 Red

dice.reading: Torso. Attack: 2 Heavy Hits and a Lightning. Defence: four hollow Defense made solid by DEF stance, one solid Defense, and one Dodge. Five Defense and one Dodge.

say: Black Die: Torso. The target Part is the RT-06 Mire Battle Core, Armor 6, Structure 2. Armor Piercing 1 reduces the pool to 5 White.
Attack: 2 Heavy Hits and 1 Lightning.
Defence, from 5 dice: 4 hollow Defense, 1 solid Defense, 1 Dodge. Defensive Stance converts the hollows, producing 5 Defense and 1 Dodge.
Defense offsets Light Hits only, and the attack contains none, so all 5 Defense icons offset nothing.
The Dodge offsets 1 Heavy Hit. The remaining Heavy Hit is unoffset, producing Penetration.
The torso has Structure 2, so it takes a Damaged Token and now contributes 2 White dice instead of 6.
The general rule this demonstrates: the number of defence dice matters less than whether the icons they produce can legally offset the incoming damage type.

steps.title: Blue answers in the south
say: Blue's Missile / Brawler fires the AC-32 Automatic Rifle: Range 6, 1 Yellow and 3 Red Dice. The [Two-Handed] range bonus does not apply, since the other hand holds the Type 55 Shield.
Target is Red's Support Skirmisher at E9, range 4, clear line of sight.
Red is in Mobility Stance, which adds Blue Dice equal to the Mech's total Dodge value. The RL-06 Standard Chassis supplies Dodge 3, so 3 Blue Dice are added.

steps.title: Mobility Stance pays it back

groups.label: Black Die, then Blue attacks: 1 Yellow + 3 Red
Red defends in MOB: 5 White + 3 Blue

dice.reading: Left Arm. Attack: 2 Heavy Hits (one hollow made solid by Offensive Stance) and 1 Light Hit. Defence: 1 Defense and 2 Dodge.

say: Black Die: Left Arm. The target Part is the Type 55 Shield and CC-6 Cleaver, Armor 5, so the pool is 5 White plus 3 Blue.
Attack: 1 solid Heavy Hit, 1 hollow Heavy Hit converted by Offensive Stance, and 1 Light Hit. Total 2 Heavy Hits and 1 Light Hit.
Defence: 1 Defense and 2 Dodge. The hollow Defense icons do not convert in Mobility Stance.
The 2 Dodge icons offset both Heavy Hits and the Defense offsets the Light Hit. Nothing is unoffset, so there is no Penetration.

Direct comparison with the previous exchange: 5 Defense icons offset 0 Heavy Hits, while 2 Dodge icons offset 2. Stance selection determines which dice colour the defender rolls, and therefore which damage types can be stopped.

steps.title: Movement timing: Red grabs a relay
say: Red's Support Skirmisher moves 1 grid, E9 to F9, onto the relay marker.
The MC-3's Guided Attack selects its target when it resolves rather than when it launches, so moving within Range 3 of the launch point does not avoid it. The move is made for position, not evasion.
Relay pressure scores at the End Phase for a M.A.P. on or adjacent to a relay, and F9 satisfies it.

steps.title: Blue walks a Mech into the centre
say: Jet Dash, I4 to G5, a distance of 3.
G5 is adjacent to the G6 control marker and also adjacent to the G4 relay marker, so one position satisfies both centre presence and relay pressure.
The Bulwark has a destroyed weapon and a Damaged torso. Neither affects scoring, because both conditions test position only. A damaged Mech on an objective scores the same as an intact one.

steps.title: Automatic Phase
say: Blue's Hyena was commanded this round, so it does not act. Red has no Drone remaining.

steps.title: Delay Phase: the missile chases
say: MC-3 Razor, Guided Attack: it selects an enemy within Range 3 and flies into that grid. F9 is 1 grid from the launch point at E9, well within range.
The missile moves to F9 and detonates. Explosion damage allows no Terrain or Unit Protection.
Red remains in Mobility Stance from its activation earlier this round, so the Blue Dice still apply on defence.

steps.title: Dodged clean

groups.label: Black Die, then missile: 3 Red + 1 Yellow
Red defends in MOB: 3 White + 3 Blue

dice.reading: Backpack. Attack: 1 Heavy Hit and 1 Light Hit, plus a hollow Heavy that stays hollow and an Eye. Defence: 1 Defense and 2 Dodge.

say: Black Die: Backpack. The target Part is the AMS-190 Active Defense System, Armor 3, so the pool is 3 White plus 3 Blue.
Attack: 1 Heavy Hit, 1 Light Hit, 1 hollow Heavy Hit and 1 Eye. The missile is not in Offensive Stance, so the hollow does not convert.
Defence: 1 Defense and 2 Dodge.
One Dodge offsets the Heavy Hit, the Defense offsets the Light Hit, and one Dodge is unused. No Penetration.
Omitted here by the teaching rules: the AMS-190 carries Intercept 3, which could have attempted to destroy the missile before it resolved.
A projectile that detonates is destroyed regardless of the outcome.

steps.title: End Phase: the final count
say: Integrity check: no Mech is at 2 or fewer Parts, so none are removed. Tokens then clear.
Red: the Support Skirmisher on the F9 relay satisfies relay pressure. No Red M.A.P. is on or adjacent to F7 or G6, so centre presence fails. Red scores 1.
Blue: the Bulwark at G5 is adjacent to G6, satisfying centre presence, and adjacent to G4, satisfying relay pressure. Blue scores 2 from that single position.

do.why: Centre presence: Bulwark adjacent to G6
Relay pressure: Bulwark adjacent to G4

steps.title: Blue wins 4 to 3
say: Final score: Blue 4, Red 3.
Damage summary: Red destroyed the AC-150 HMG and applied a Damaged Token to the Bulwark's torso. Blue destroyed Red's Hyena drone and applied a Damaged Token to the Fire Support's chassis.
VP summary: Red scored Part destruction once and relay pressure twice. Blue scored Projectile lesson and Drone kill once each, then took 2 in the final round from one correctly placed Mech.

The margin came from position at the End Phase rather than from damage. Part destruction and Drone kill pay once per game; centre presence and relay pressure pay in every round they are held, which rewards reading the scoring conditions before selecting targets.
Variations worth testing: Red committing a second Mech south from round 1 to contest both relays, or Blue using Mobility Stance in the north lane to blunt the railgun.
